newsitem.title: ITALY: Al-Waleed said remaining in Mediaset - press.
newsitem.headline: Al-Waleed said remaining in Mediaset - press.

text.p: Saudi billionaire investor Prince Al-Waleed Bin Talal intends to keep his stake in Italian media group Mediaset for the time being, a spokesman for the prince told Milan-based financial weekly Il Mondo.

Tarek ben Ammar, a Tunisian film producer in charge of media strategy in Saudi Arabia, was quoted as saying the prince aimed to keep his investment long after April 12, the date until which Mediaset's main foreign shareholders were originally committed to hold on to their stakes.

Main foreign partners in the TV and advertising group, in which Silvio Berlusconi is the main shareholder, are Germany's Kirch group with just over five percent, media group Nethold with some 6.5 percent and Al-Waleed with over two percent.
